text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, pure and immaculate Holy Hoof Festival! But beyond this point
lies my created realm, the 'Castle of Demonic Temptation'!
I shall entice you all into sweet, delectable depravity."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Come! Give in to your desires,
and intoxicate yourself in this luscious paradise!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff A
text_block_list.text:
We're hosting an authentic castle-style Halloween café!
The food and the decor are top quality!
Please stop by the 'Castle of Demonic Temptation'~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's amazing, Shakur!
Even the furniture looks so authentic!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't know, don't care. Just hurry up and order.
A coffee for me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
—Where is... Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll have some tea.
...By the way, Chris, what's your costume supposed to be?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—I am... the commander of the automatons.
Entertaining guests is... my duty.”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
How lovely!
Is everything going smoothly with the other guests?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
There is no problem.
............However, ――

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Do you feel like something's missing?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Then, a piece of advice.
Why not add some stage direction to enhance the mood?
For example, fully committing to the role of a mechanical doll—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Holy Hoof Festival was bustling once again this year.
Curious to see how Symboli Kris S was doing, I went to check out her class's booth.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff B
text_block_list.text:
"—Whenever you are ready to order,
please call over one of the dolls over there♪"
choice_data_list: When you say the dolls...

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
“—Excuse me, Miss Automaton!
Could I get a refill on water, please~?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
—Bamboo, water, please.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Water... Ah, refills for table 5, right!
Right on it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yaeno—Table 3, please.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Table 3...
Ah, their food is delayed. I'll handle it.
choice_data_list: (Looks like they're participating properly this year.)
(Looks like they're participating properly this year.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her coordination with her classmates is working out well...
or rather, it seems those around her have learned to understand her.
Seeing her progress brings a smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. ...Welcome.
choice_data_list: You're working hard, huh.
You're working so hard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. Now that I have been given a role—I will execute it—with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...May I take your order?
choice_data_list: In that case, coffee and cake, please...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —As you wish—My Lord.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —As you wish—My Lady.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: If there is anything I can do—please do not hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If it is—for my liege's sake—
I am prepared to stake my very life.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is—the supreme joy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*murmur*)
choice_data_list: W-What's the matter all of a sudden...?!
W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...?
—Did I... do something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I received—advice—from Fine.
So—I came up—with a performance—
to build up—the atmosphere... but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Was it incomplete?
choice_data_list: No, that's not true, but...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's lovely customer service that fits the shop's atmosphere.
Though, coming from her, it feels a bit too surprising—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Haha, BWAHAHAHAHA!
What a truly magnificent performance, my loyal automaton!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—this is a castle of depravity.
Therefore, we must kneel in devotion and become the 'serpent that encroaches upon paradise.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: O, Your Highness. Please, grant me the honor of offering you the sacred waters of the River Lethe.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful. I'll leave it to you, then.
Make sure to brew me an exquisite cup.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, my beautiful and loyal automaton!
You too shall offer our beloved masters
a supreme, magnificent moment!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Well then—My Lord.
Your command—duly noted and accepted.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeth...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Well then—My Lady.
Your command—duly noted and accepted.
choice_data_list: Y-Yeth...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Afterward, their stall did booming business.
At the same time, Symboli Kris S's overwhelmingly intense customer service
became quite the talk of the crowd."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...May I take your order?
choice_data_list: In that case, coffee and cake, please...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —As you wish—My Lord.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —As you wish—My Lady.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: If there is anything I can do—please do not hesitate to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
If it is—for my liege's sake—
I am prepared to stake my very life.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is—the supreme joy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*murmur*)
choice_data_list: W-What's the matter all of a sudden...?!
W-What's gotten into you all of a sudden...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...?
—Did I... do something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I received—advice—from Fine.
So—I came up—with a performance—
to build up—the atmosphere... but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—However...
Did I... not do it right?
choice_data_list: No, well, I did manage to do it, but...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I see. Then—please, give your orders.
My beloved—Liege.

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
—Eep... If that happened to me, I'd die...
—I-I don't have the courage to order...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...That being said, she might want to moderate it a bit more.
While persuading her of this, I was once again struck by her purity."

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
—Kris S-chan!
We're in trouble, our bread dough stock is...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—!
—I will deal with it immediately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies, Trainer.
I'll have to keep you waiting... for a little bit.
choice_data_list: No, I'd be glad to help if you like!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
—And so, we're running low on bread dough.
We need to make more in a rush, but everyone's completely tied up working the dining room...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. I will—handle things here.
You—continue with the hall.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Trainer—
Make the dough—with me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them relentlessly
kneaded bread dough over and over—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—If I make this many—
it should—last for today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—You really saved me.
You must be tired—are you alright?
choice_data_list: Yeah, actually, it was kind of fun.
Yeah, I actually had fun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I see— Truly—thank you.
—You have saved this shop.
choice_data_list: No, no, that's going a bit too far—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
You are... magnificent. Amazing.
I... only exist because of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I am... grateful—I wish to thank you.
A reward—today's... compensation.
choice_data_list: A-A reward...!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I shall grant... anything.
Just as... you desire.
choice_data_list: Stop, stop! What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?
Stop, stop! What's gotten into you all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――?
Hard work should be met with... appreciation, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
That too—is the duty—of a commander.
I learned that—from Fine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—some sort of—reward.
Please—make a request.
choice_data_list: W-Well, maybe I'll have some tea...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. ...From working behind the scenes—
I know where... the good tea leaves are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After that, they treated me with such lavish hospitality
during my break that I felt a little fidgety.
